entities.title: Icelandic word lists
entities.summary: Icelandic word lists for original party games (code-clue, grid-clue, outsider, describe-around-traps, category race, one-syllable describing), built from the Árni Magnússon Institute's open data.
entities.purpose: Holds the data in data/ (common nouns with per-game suitability, 16-word topic grids, category prompts, one-syllable word forms, and the unused rare-word list from the abandoned bluff game) and in research/ the report, rejected words and the tools that built the lists. No game code lives here.
boundaries: No package.json, so CI neither builds nor deploys this folder.
Every word is checked against the institute's datasets or málið.is; unconfirmed items are listed in each entry's ostadfest field.
